senses.gloss:
गञ्ज् गञ्ज्, cl. 1. P. गञ्जति, &c., to sound,
give out a particular sound.

गञ्ज गञ्ज, अस्, अम्, m. n. = گنج a
treasury, a jewel room, the place where plate &c.
is preserved; (अस्, आ, अम्), m. f. n. a mine, a jewel
mine; (अस्), m. a cowhouse or station of cowherds;
a mart, a place where grain &c. is stored for sale;
disrespect, contempt; (आ), f. a tavern, a drinking-
vessel (especially one for intoxicating liquors); a hut,
a hovel, the abode of low people; (? wrong reading
for गुञ्जा) the plant Guñjā or Retti, Abrus Preca-
torius; [cf. गगण-गञ्ज and धर्म-गञ्ज.]

गञ्जन, अस्, आ, अम्, contemning, conquering,
excelling.

गञ्जवर, अस्, m. a treasurer, = گنجور a royal
treasury (?).

गञ्जाकिनी गञ्जाकिनी, f. anything made of
hemp (?); perhaps गृञ्जाकिनी (?).
गाञ्जिकाय गाञ्जिकाय, अस्, m. a quail.
